Colour and fill scales for populations

Source: R/palettes.R
scale_colour_superpop.Rd

ggplot2 scales that apply the fixed snpscaper colours (superpop_colours, pop_colours), so the same population always has the same colour.

Usage

scale_colour_superpop(...)

scale_fill_superpop(...)

scale_colour_pop(...)

scale_fill_pop(...)

Arguments

...

Passed on to ggplot2::scale_colour_manual() or ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(), for example name or breaks.

Value

A ggplot2 scale.

Examples

library(ggplot2)
#> Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.6.1
df <- data.frame(super_pop = names(superpop_colours), n = c(661, 347, 504, 503, 489))
ggplot(df, aes(super_pop, n, fill = super_pop)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_superpop() +
  theme_jb()
